build_wav2vec2_model: build a Wav2Vec2Model with frontend, encoder, masker, and quantizer components for audio pretraining
run_wav2vec2_forward: run the Wav2Vec2Model forward pass on audio sequences to get contrastive loss and output
extract_wav2vec2_features: extract features from audio sequences using the Wav2Vec2Model encoder frontend and transformer encoder
compute_wav2vec2_contrastive_loss: compute the contrastive loss from logits using cross-entropy with the target at index zero
quantize_and_contrast_wav2vec2: quantize targets and produce logits for contrastive prediction using the Wav2Vec2Model quantizer
